concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage — 'T005 and T006 are parallelizable after T004'
concerns.text: T005 and T006 are declared parallelizable, but both implement functions in the SAME module (`code/robustness.py`) and both add cases to the SAME test file (`tests/unit/test_robustness.py`). Concurrent execution creates a merge conflict / shared-file race. Either sequence them (T005 → T006) or split the module/test files so the parallel claim is actually safe.
